headers.comment: Default: never cache. Firebase applies the LAST matching rule, so the broad rule goes first and the specific ones below override it. This covers the app shell (every SPA route serves /index.html), sw.js, registerSW.js, workbox-*.js and the manifest — all unhashed, all must be refetched so a new deploy takes effect on the next launch.
Everything Vite fingerprints lives here — safe to cache forever.
Icons are unhashed and referenced by the manifest, so cache them for a week rather than a year — a rebrand then lands in days, not months.
